handoffs.message: Auto-reassigned MPOS-P1-MEM-002 away from unavailable lane Codex2 (disabled, sidecar-only, or auth-down); owner Codex2 -> Codex.

Ready for review. Implementation PR #1267 merged into dev at 4e0e52d7dd6acb7c601da2e1f6be7cefb3e8c62f; task commit 03fb70acc2cf7a8b856f869ebcc22e00b60eb510. Scope: memory Learn feedback writeback endpoint/adapter, source-event idempotency, telemetry/incident/evolution payload builders, and focused acceptance tests. Local validation: memory unittest suite, telemetry feedback adapter unittest, incident/evolution unittest, py_compile, git diff --check. Note: MPOS-P1-E2E-002 remains active, so this proves event-level writeback contract with synthetic runtime telemetry evidence rather than full paper LEAN E2E.

Review approved. Implementation verified: 17 test_main.py tests pass (including 5 new learn-feedback writeback tests), 56 memory store tests pass, 29 feedback_adapter tests pass, 94 incident/postmortem_bridge tests pass. All acceptance criteria met: persona and institutional memory writebacks created from telemetry/postmortem/evolution outcomes; sponsor persona id propagated to institutional entries; contributor entries carry proposal_ids and runtime_telemetry_evidence; idempotent replay returns HTTP 200 on duplicate source_event_id; unauthorized authority rejected 403. Owner must finalize.
